description:
• Brand Introduction:

Vampire Art Ltd is an English registered company selling fashion and accessories online through the portal vampire-art.com. We combine vintage and retro styles with grunge, goth and modern trends such as dark academia and cottagecore. We mainly operate through Print-on-Demand.

  • Product description:

We sell apparel, shoes, textiles for the house and other items. We take care of the design and we rely on our partners for the manufacturing and printing part.

• USP (unique selling point):

Alternative design based on retro motifs combined with niche styles. Our products are unique as they are based on our own designs.

• Payment terms:

Commissions are paid within 7 days from checkout by customers through Paypal.

• Other information:

All affiliates must comply with our brand guidelines. Further information will be provided after successful registration.

Our team is always available to answer questions and provide support.

Invalid Activities: Any form of fraudulent activity, including but not limited to the use of robotic or software-driven purchases, will result in cancellation of the commission and possible termination of the partnership.

Disclaimer: Vampire Art is not liable for any indirect or anticipated losses arising from this affiliate program and our entire liability is limited to the actual commission amount earned.

Changes to the program: Vampire Art reserves the right to change the terms and conditions of this affiliate program at any time.

Termination: Either party may terminate the partnership at any time. In the event of termination by Vampire Art Ltd due to violations of the guidelines, no commissions will be paid.

Taxes: It is the Affiliate's responsibility to pay any required taxes on commissions earned through the Affiliate Program.
